title: Gear
description: A piece of gear (#690): a player-facing name, the slot it goes into, its rarity (#291), for spikes their damage (#692), for ward gear whether it keeps the passives on (#617), for a unique item, of rarity bound, its codex entry (#1449), and its model (#1581). One file per piece, named after its id. Each player's gear is kept in their profile by its id, so an id is never reused or changed once shipped.

id.description: Stable, never reused: lowercase words joined by underscores.

slot.description: The slot it goes into (owner, #223): ward (warding gear and totems), trap (spikes) or throw (berries).

rarity.description: Its rarity (#291), lowest to highest, then bound for uniques and artifacts.

damage.description: Spikes only (#692), which trap gear always is: the damage the ring deals once a second to each wild monster pushing on it, never below 1 HP.

model.description: Its model (#1581), which its gear slot shows: a res:// path to a glTF model under assets/. Every item has one. The game checks it exists.

keeps_passives.description: Unique ward gear only, of rarity bound (#617): while it's in the ward slot, the passives of every monster the player carries that hasn't fainted work, out or not, instead of only the out companion's.

codex.description: Unique items only, of rarity bound (#1449): the codex entry the player reads on its codex page once they've held it.

entry.description: A short text about it and where its name comes from.
